while True:
    try:
        length = int(input())
        line = input()
        text = list(line)

        maxWordSize = 0
        totalWords = 0
        currentSize = 0
        position = 0

        while position < length:
            ch = text[position]

            if ch != '_' and ch != '(' and ch != ')':
                currentSize += 1
            elif ch == '_':
                maxWordSize = max(maxWordSize, currentSize)
                currentSize = 0
            elif ch == '(':
                maxWordSize = max(maxWordSize, currentSize)
                currentSize = 0
                position += 1
                while position < length and text[position] != ')' and text[position] != '_':
                    ch_inner = text[position]
                    if ch_inner != '_' and ch_inner != '(' and ch_inner != ')':
                        currentSize += 1
                    elif ch_inner == '_':
                        if currentSize != 0:
                            totalWords += 1
                            currentSize = 0
                    elif ch_inner == ')':
                        if currentSize != 0:
                            totalWords += 1
                            currentSize = 0
                        break
                    position += 1
            position += 1

        maxWordSize = max(maxWordSize, currentSize)
        print(f"{maxWordSize} {totalWords}")
    except EOFError:
        break
